name: One October 20 NBA pilot

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/nba-20261020-pilot.yml
      - multisport_lab/pilot_github.py
      - multisport_lab/scheduled_cycle.py
      - tests/test_pilot_github.py
      - tests/test_scheduled_cycle.py
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    # One eligible date; the worker verifies 2026 and disables this workflow
    # before live collection. GitHub cron can start late; timing gates still apply.
    - cron: '15 17 20 10 *'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: nba-20261020-401909088-t90
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  pilot:
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'NickNicky19/Nicks-multisport-lab-project' &&
      (github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
       (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
        github.head_ref != 'records/nba-20261020-401909088-t90'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      actions: write
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      NML_PILOT_CRON: ${{ github.event.schedule }}
      NML_EXPECTED_CHECKOUT_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Verify executor or run the single eligible pilot
        id: worker
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = schedule ]; then
            python3 -m multisport_lab.pilot_github execute
          else
            python3 -m multisport_lab.pilot_github preflight
          fi
      - name: Verify preserved software and research artifact
        id: checks
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
          python3 -m multisport_lab.demo
          node --test --test-isolation=none web/tests/*.test.mjs
          python3 -m multisport_lab.publication --build-commit "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          node web/tests/site-smoke.mjs output
          sha256sum --check --quiet MANIFEST.sha256
      - name: Prepare factual records PR without merging
        if: >-
          always() && steps.checks.conclusion == 'success'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = schedule ]; then
            python3 -m multisport_lab.pilot_github publication-pr
          else
            python3 -m multisport_lab.pilot_github publication-pr --draft
          fi
      - name: Retain emergency recovery evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: nba-20261020-pilot-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: false
          path: |
            records/
            evidence/cycles/
            HANDOFF_STATUS.md
            MANIFEST.sha256
